metadata.description: One-click install of the management-portal MCP operator for Claude Code — the MCP server plus the full agent discipline (skills, portal-operator subagent, /portal and /rearm-watch commands, read-after-write hooks).

plugins.name: management-portal
plugins.description: Operate the management-portal MCP with the full agent discipline - the core loop, the three gates (read-after-write, completeness, task-breakdown), bottom-up completion, never-fabricate-ids, and board-first. Sign in with OAuth on first use; no API key to paste or store. Bundles the MCP server, the management-portal skill, the team-chat-reachability skill and its team-chat-watcher sub-agent, the portal-operator subagent, the /portal and /rearm-watch commands, and the read-after-write hooks.
